title: DIA/NRO witness imaging objects in space

tellings.quote: And yet I have a disclosure project witness that worked for DIA and with and also NRO imaging these objects okay out in space

plain: Steven Greer, a doctor who runs the Disclosure Project, an effort to collect testimony from government and military insiders about UFOs, says one of his witnesses worked for the DIA, the Pentagon's military intelligence agency, and with the NRO, the US agency that runs spy satellites. According to Greer, this witness's job involved taking images of unknown objects out in space. If true, it would mean US intelligence has been quietly photographing these objects in orbit.
